findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed half & half and opened orange juice in the clear door standing cooler at 47F (probed). The half & half and opened orange juice were discarded during the inspection. The PIC was advised to store any TCS foods in the bottom of the prep cooler. Ensure that all TSC foods are maintained at 41F or less.

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed a mop being stored with the head on the floor of the mop sink. Ensure that mops are placed in a position that allows the head to air dry. An employee moved the mop into a position where the head can air dry during the inspection. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Sanitizer bucket had a concentration of <100 ppm (q).  Discussed with PIC and employee and also showed the employee how to check the concentration of the sanitizer.  Ensure sanitizer buckets are changed regularly.

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
Ice scoop was observed laying in the ice bin.  The handle does have a shield on one side of the scoop, but the other side is exposed.  Discussed with employee to store the scoop in the holder on the side of the ice bin when not in use.  Ensure ice scoop is stored properly to prevent contamination.

3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Salads held in the clear door cooler were 50F.  Discussed with PIC, salads were discarded.  Ensure food items are held on the top shelf and drinks on the shelves underneath to so foods are held at the proper cold holding temperature.

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Ice machine was observed to contain a build-up of mold on baffles.  Baffles are a food-contact surface and shall be clean to sight and touch to prevent contamination of ice.  Ensure ice machine is regularly cleaned to prevent build-up of mold and debris. 

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Test strips were not present at time of inspection.  Test strips must be present at all times during business hours to measure the concentration of sanitizer solutions/wipes to ensure proper concentration.  Ensure tests strips are stocked and available at all times.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Wall outlet cover is missing on the wall by the cooler.  Wall covering materials shall be attached at all times so they are easily cleanable and help prevent pests from entering facility.  Ensure outlet cover is placed over outlet.

6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.comment:
3-801.11: (D) FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact READY-TO-EAT FOOD as specified under ¶¶ 3-301.11(B) and (E). 

Observed the ice scoop handle in contact with ice at the beverage station. Discussed with present staff member, see that scoop is kept out of the ice in between uses so as to not create a cross contamination risk between the handle and ice. COS- Moved to a paper bowl outside of the ice bin.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Test strips not present at Halfway House. Ensure test strips are permanently kept at this location so staff on the golf course can adequately measure sanitizer concentrations throughout the day. COS. Manager brought extra quat test strips from the main house to the Halfway House.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

Upon inspector arrival, a garbage can was observed placed in front of the hand sink. Inspector moved trash can. Ensure staff do not block the handwashing sinks at any time with garbage cans or other equipment.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Test strips not present at Halfway House. Ensure test strips are permanently kept at this location so staff on the golf course can adequately measure sanitizer concentrations throughout the day. COS. Manager brought extra quat test strips from the main house to the Halfway House.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) 

Observed 2 dead ants inside soda gun by the window. Discussed with PIC. Ensure soda gun is stored in such a way where pests do not have access to them. Routinely clean the soda gun to ensure pests do not remain in soda gun.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14  (Pf) Test kits or other devices are not available to the employees to measure sanitizing solution concentration. Provide a test kit or other measuring device so the employees can measure concentrations and ensure proper sanitization. Avoid a concentration of sanitizer that is too high, which can be toxic. Reference 4-302.14.

No test kits at concession stand at golf course. Strips are kept in the chef's kitchen at the main house. Manager will bring strips to concession stand. Corrected on sight.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) Date marking is not on egg beaters. Food shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a food establishment and if the food is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the food shall be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded, when held at a temperature of 41 deg F or less for a maximum of 7 days (not exceeding a manufacturer's use-by date). Discussed applicable sections of 3-501.17 and reviewed HACCP concepts with person in charge. Food was labeled. Reference 3-501.17.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111  (Pf) ants observed, live, in the soda nozzle . The premises shall be maintained free of insects, rodents and other pests. Eliminate ants, using proper pest control processes as needed. Reference 6-501.111.

Facility uses ant traps in appropriate places, but ants are still getting near food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.citation_text:
6-305.11  (C) Employee clothing and personal items were found stored improperly. Food establishments shall A) Provide designated dressing rooms or dressing areas for employees that routinely change their clothes in the establishment; B) Provide lockers or other suitable facilities for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. Reference 6-305.11.

Sweaters observed on rack in kitchen. Ensure employee clothing is stored away from kitchen food prep areas.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 1) Observed no date marking on milk being stored in refrigerator. All items being used beyond 24 hours must be date marked and discarded after 7 days of use. 2) Observed milk to be out of temperature (47 F) for unknown amount of time. All items must be maintained at or below 41F. Item was discarded. 750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above) 750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days. Make sure to thouroughly clean the lines in the milk cooler.

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed milk cooler being used with coffee machine to be out of temperature (47F). All coolers must be capable of maintaining a temperature of 41F or below. Cooler will no longer be used. 
750-140 All refrigeration units used to store potentially hazardous foods shall be able to maintain proper product temperature at 41°F or below.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed rubber and metal spatula to be severly damaged with cracks and chips. 
2) Observed ice bucket to be damaged with cracks on bottom.
3) Observed pan with severe crevices and a food contact surface that is scored.
All food-contact utensils and equipment must be smooth, in good repair, and easily cleanable
750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed cutting board to have crevices and be out of good repair. Cutting board must be in good repair and be easily cleanable. 
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed ice machine to have yellow debris build up. Ice machines must be clean as needed to prevent possible cross contamination.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: 750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food. Observed the ice bin to be exposed upon inspector arrival. Close the ice bin when not in use. The ice bin was closed during the inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750.1220-Floors shall be kept clean. 
Observed that the floor drain catch basin has some build up at the bottom.
Clean the floor drain catch basin.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750.830g-Chemical test strips shall be provided for checking sanitizing solutions.
Observed that this facility did not have test strips onsite for checking sanitizer concentration.
Provide test strips.
CORRECTED= test strips were obtained from main building during inspection.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: The shelf the hot water heater is on is not finished wood. Paint or seal top and bottom of shelf to make for a smooth and easily cleanable surface. 750.1210b

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment: No certified food manager present. During any operating hours when service or food prep occurs, provide a certified food manager. 750.540

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e Tea machine surface is soiled. Clean and sanitize the machine.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220  Floor drain under three compartment sink is soiled.  Clean the drain.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment: 750.120a: Burger in warmer at 114-123 F.  Cooked prior to opening. Keep for maximum 4 hours, then discard.  A log will be kept or a policy will be in place.
